sources.title: xtts-v2: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Technical specifications xtts-v2 is a transformer-based text-to-speech model that performs voice cloning and multilingual synthesis. The architecture accepts speaker reference audio and synthesizes new speech by conditioning on speaker embeddings extracted from the reference clip.

sources.snippet: XTTS v2 is an open-source AI model for text-to-speech conversion and voice cloning. Learn about its capabilities, use cases, and how to get started with this Coqui community-developed tool.
